prompt: Build a settings form with two sections: 'Profile' (first name, last name, bio textarea) and 'Notifications' (email notifications switch, SMS notifications switch, notification frequency select with options Daily/Weekly/Monthly). Use a grouped layout.
assertions: Uses Input for name fields, Textarea for bio, Switch for toggles, Select+Option for frequency
Groups fields into visual sections (headings, Details, or Card sections)
Uses wa-stack for vertical field flow
Select has Option children with value props (Daily, Weekly, Monthly)
Installs all needed components via npx kigumi add
Every form control has a label prop
